onboarding_welcome_description: Your bots run on this computer, with your own model accounts. Three short steps and you can start chatting.
onboarding_welcome_approvals: Choose how bots ask before they act
onboarding_model_description: Bots need a model to think with. Sign in with a Claude or ChatGPT plan, or paste an API key. You can add more in Settings.
onboarding_approvals_description: Each bot has a permission mode. You pick it for your first bot in the next step, and can change it any time.
onboarding_approvals_jev_hint: Optional. Auto mode sends risky tool calls to Jev, TypeSafe's safety model. Without a key, Auto asks you instead.
onboarding_bot_description: Give it a name, a model and a permission mode. Instructions, skills and tools can wait.
onboarding_bot_description_existing: Give it a name, a model and a permission mode. You already have bots, so you can skip this.
onboarding_done_description: {bot} is ready. Providers, tools and skills live in Settings when you need them.
onboarding_done_description_no_bot: Providers, tools and skills live in Settings when you need them.
onboarding_scene_bot_answer: Hi, I'm {name}. Tell me what to work on.
